task.description: DESIGN AMENDMENT to the already-gate-approved lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md, resolving its own explicitly-flagged OQ-2 (design section 8) before this run merges. Read OQ-2 in full in the design doc, and read handoffs/WF03-ISS0732-20260921/step-04-security-reviewer.json's result.issues for a sibling SECURITY-REVIEWER pass's concrete finding: Letflow.Definitions.get_latest_assertion_run/2 has no `status` filter, so the MOST RECENT PromotionAssertionRun row for a review could still be `status: :running` (rehearsal in progress, not yet finished) at the moment apply_review/4's verify_rehearsed/2 reads it -- and because `assertions_failed` defaults to `0` at insert time (insert_changeset/2) and is only ever written by update_changeset/2 when the run actually completes, an in-flight, not-yet-finished rehearsal currently satisfies verify_rehearsed/2's gate exactly as if it had already passed. ORCH's ruling (concurred by a sibling ORCH session): this must be closed before merge -- it reintroduces a narrower version of the exact defect ISS-0732 exists to fix (an unrehearsed-or-not-actually-passed change reaching release). Design the fix: decide and state explicitly whether the check should require `assertion_run.status == :passed` (in ADDITION to `assertions_failed == 0`, since a `:teardown_failed` run with `assertions_failed == 0` is still a documented green gate per R8's own contract -- so `status == :passed` alone would be WRONG, it would reject a legitimate teardown-failed-but-assertions-passed rehearsal) or `assertion_run.status not in [:running]` (excluding only the in-progress state, admitting both :passed and :teardown_failed as before) -- state which of these two you choose and why, since they are NOT equivalent (the first rejects a valid teardown-failed pass; get this right, it is exactly the kind of R8-contract-consistency question this run has already been careful about twice). State the exact updated verify_rehearsed/2 (or renamed) logic as a signature/type-shape amendment to section 3 of the existing design doc (append an amendment section, do not rewrite the whole doc from scratch) -- no full function bodies, same design-doc convention as before.
acceptance_criteria: Amendment explicitly resolves OQ-2 with a stated, justified choice between the two candidate fixes described above (or a third option, if justified)

Amendment does not silently reintroduce a status == :passed-only check that would reject a legitimate :teardown_failed + assertions_failed == 0 run (this would contradict R8's own already-documented gate condition and is a regression trap this run has hit before)
Amendment states the exact updated with-chain/verify_rehearsed logic as signatures/type-shapes/prose only, no executable Elixir code
Amendment is appended to the existing design doc as a new section, not a full rewrite
Amendment states what changes (if any) are needed in error-reason naming/HTTP-response mapping as a result of this stricter check

result.summary: Resolved OQ-2 by appending a new section 9 ("AMENDMENT (2026-09-21) - resolving OQ-2") to lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md. Chose candidate (B): require assertion_run.status not in [:running] as an ADDITIONAL condition alongside the existing assertions_failed == 0 check, not a replacement for it, and not candidate (A) (status == :passed), which was rejected because it would reject a legitimate :teardown_failed + assertions_failed == 0 run, contradicting R8's already-documented gate contract. verify_rehearsed/2's step 3 (new) checks status not in [:running] before the renumbered step 4 (assertions_failed == 0, unchanged), because a :running row's assertions_failed is always 0 by construction (insert_changeset/2 defaults) so the old check alone would never distinguish an in-flight rehearsal from a genuinely passed one. Added one new apply_review_error() union member, :assertion_run_in_progress (distinct from :assertion_run_missing and :assertion_run_failed), one new worked example, one new render_apply/2 clause mapped to 409 Conflict (same rationale as the three existing new clauses - a precondition-not-met/conflicts-with-current-state case, not 422, not folded into invalid_transition_response/1), and restated INV-NEW-1 as strengthened (status not :running AND assertions_failed == 0). get_latest_assertion_run/2 itself is deliberately left unchanged (no new status filter added to its query) per OQ-2's own suggested resolution path - the fix lives entirely in verify_rehearsed/2's branching on the already-returned row.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR to re-gate the amended design doc before ELIXIR-DEV implements verify_rehearsed/2's updated logic.
